summary: Implementation plan to fix the 'App not installed as package appears to be invalid' error on fresh APK installs from GitHub Releases by disabling configuration-cache poisoning of release signing variables, adding a dedicated Android SDK zipalign + apksigner (V1+V2+V3) signing and verification script, setting extractNativeLibs=true in AndroidManifest.xml, using a deterministic fallback keystore across releases, and streamlining the pipeline to publish only the verified Universal APK and SHA-256 checksums.
